description: This file defines the OpenClawChatViewModel class, which manages the state and interactions related to a chat UI in an OpenClaw application. It handles message exchanges, session management, model selection, event processing, and communication with the transport layer.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: A view model managing chat session state, message history, model choices, and interaction logic for the OpenClaw UI.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the initial chat session data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the current input message and attachments.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Selects a different thinking level for the session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects a different AI model for the session.

methods.name: addImageAttachment
methods.description: Adds an image file as an attachment.

methods.name: removeAttachment
methods.description: Removes an attachment by its ID.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes chat-related events from the transport layer.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Processes agent-related events from the transport layer.

methods.name: refreshHistoryAfterRun
methods.description: Refreshes message history after a run completes.
